title: BAI to Host Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches, directly impacting player development across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is organizing an Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, running from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Changes Announced for Women's Doubles Pair in World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This notification directly affects the composition of India's junior women's doubles team for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, following earlier notifications on player eligibility for the Cairo event.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's promising young talent for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on junior player development.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a significant domestic team event, shaping the competitive landscape for Indian states and fostering national talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has published the official regulations for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for the upcoming national competition.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This rule change will significantly impact how young Indian players compete in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships, potentially influencing their development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
